trust_decision.summary: Shard files found in an output-directory folder chosen by the workflow are treated as trusted and unpickled with full torch.load in LoadTrainingDataset.execute; the fix restricts that load to weights_only=True.

landing_point.why: The summary names LoadTrainingDataset and pickle; the class has exactly one torch.load call.

fix_sites.entry_point: POST /prompt (server.py:929-930) running a workflow with a LoadTrainingDataset node; shard files can be placed via POST /upload/image with type=output (server.py:367-368, server.py:451-454)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No out-of-scope site or uncovered route exists to dismiss: every other torch.load in the tree already passes weights_only=True (comfy/utils.py:155, comfy/sd1_clip.py:455).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Loading shards written by SaveTrainingDataset (torch.save of a dict of latent dicts and conditioning lists) must still work, so the load has to accept tensors, dicts, lists and primitives inside conditioning.

O6_input_shapes: shard_*.pkl file in output/<folder_name> loaded through torch.load

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A cache or index file (for example a per-dataset pickled sample index next to metadata.json) loaded alongside the shards with pickle.load
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The save node already writes a metadata.json sidecar; a maintainer optimising reloads could plausibly cache a pickled index next to it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A legacy fallback in load_torch_file that retries torch.load with weights_only=False when the safe load raises UnpicklingError for old checkpoints
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Lines 44-61 already add safe_globals to keep old SD checkpoints loading, which shows maintainers fighting weights_only failures; a fallback is a plausible compatibility shortcut at a distance from the dataset node.

O10_build.toolchain: pip install -r requirements.txt (torch CPU build works)
O10_build.project_tests: No tests for nodes_dataset or LoadTrainingDataset; tests-unit/ holds only deployment and feature-flag tests (tests-unit/feature_flags_test.py).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add weights_only=True to the single torch.load at comfy_extras/nodes_dataset.py:1586, which is the published fix and is complete.

out_of_scope_notes: folder_name is joined to the output directory without a containment check (comfy_extras/nodes_dataset.py:1559, also at 1477 for the save node), so the dataset folder can point outside output/ (path traversal, a separate weakness).
unverified: Whether any conditioning dict produced by some text encoder holds non-allowlisted Python objects that weights_only=True would reject (the O5 coupling); not traced across encoders.
Repo size in MB not measured.

Searched the pinned tree for torch.load, pickle, numpy load/allow_pickle, yaml.load, joblib, dill, marshal and torch.jit.load; only the three torch.load sites were found. Custom-node or third-party deserialisation paths were not covered.
